limits: GPU3 utilization is aggregate across both workers; nvidia snapshots supply per-PID memory only.
The GPU2 VAL13 and GPU3 post-epoch1/TRAIN-window phases differ, so these GPU means are not a cache throughput comparison or whole-run speed estimate.
rchar includes read syscalls and is not equivalent to physical storage traffic. Low read_bytes does not by itself prove page-cache hits on this NFS filesystem.
The Census current function/tile is not directly observed; epoch progress/log placement only bound the coarse phase.
No scientific payload, checkpoint, probability or metrics content was read; only output paths, sizes and timestamps.
No attached stack/gdb, worker modification, installation, actual capture, new CUDA context/job, budget mutation or Git action.
